title: The behaviour change wheel: a new method for characterising and designing behaviour change interventions
authors: Michie S, van Stralen MM, West R
note: Framework-development paper (systematic search of 19 existing frameworks, expert consultation); defines COM-B and the nine intervention functions. Not an effectiveness study.

title: The behavior change technique taxonomy (v1) of 93 hierarchically clustered techniques: building an international consensus for the reporting of behavior change interventions
authors: Michie S, Richardson M, Johnston M, Abraham C, Francis J, Hardeman W, Eccles MP, Cane J, Wood CE
note: Delphi-type expert consensus on a reporting taxonomy; abstract only. Describes techniques, not their effectiveness.

title: Effective techniques in healthy eating and physical activity interventions: a meta-regression
authors: Michie S, Abraham C, Whittington C, McAteer J, Gupta S
note: 122 evaluations, N = 44,747 adults; abstract only. More than 10 years old; findings broadly consistent with later reviews (Samdal 2017, Howlett 2019).

title: Are physical activity interventions for healthy inactive adults effective in promoting behavior change and maintenance, and which behavior change techniques are effective? A systematic review and meta-analysis
authors: Howlett N, Trivedi D, Troop NA, Chater AM
note: 26 RCTs (16 pooled) in healthy inactive adults with at least 6 months follow-up.

title: Effective behaviour change techniques for physical activity and healthy eating in overweight and obese adults; systematic review and meta-regression analyses
authors: Samdal GB, Eide GE, Barth T, Williams G, Meland E
venue: Int J Behav Nutr Phys Act
note: 48 RCTs of at least 12 weeks; adults with mean age 40 or more and mean BMI 30 or more.

title: Exercise, physical activity, and self-determination theory: a systematic review
authors: Teixeira PJ, Carraça EV, Markland D, Silva MN, Ryan RM
venue: Int J Behav Nutr Phys Act
note: Systematic review of 66 studies, mostly non-experimental designs; more than 10 years old.

title: A meta-analysis of self-determination theory-informed intervention studies in the health domain: effects on motivation, health behavior, physical, and psychological health
authors: Ntoumanis N, Ng JYY, Prestwich A, Quested E, Hancox JE, Thøgersen-Ntoumani C, Deci EL, Ryan RM, Lonsdale C, Williams GC
note: 73 experimental studies across health behaviours; abstract only (no effect sizes in abstract).

title: Motivational interviewing: a systematic review and meta-analysis
authors: Rubak S, Sandbaek A, Lauritzen T, Christensen B
note: 72 RCTs across many conditions (not specific to physical activity). More than 10 years old; superseded for physical activity outcomes by Zhu 2024.

title: Effectiveness of behavioural interventions with motivational interviewing on physical activity outcomes in adults: systematic review and meta-analysis
authors: Zhu S, Sinha D, Kirk M, Michalopoulou M, Hajizadeh A, Wren G, Doody P, Mackillop L, Smith R, Jebb SA, Astbury NM
note: 97 RCTs, 27,811 adults; GRADE certainty low to very low.

title: Motivational Interviewing Treatment Integrity Coding Manual 4.2.1
authors: Moyers TB, Manuel JK, Ernst D
venue: Unpublished manual, University of New Mexico CASAA
note: Coding manual for MI fidelity, revised June 2015. Pages are marked 'Draft: Do not cite without permission'; the manual itself states its competence thresholds are expert opinion without validity data. Used only to describe MI-consistent and MI-inconsistent communication behaviours.

title: Unique effects of setting goals on behavior change: Systematic review and meta-analysis
authors: Epton T, Currie S, Armitage CJ
note: 141 papers, 384 effect sizes, N = 16,523; across many behaviours, not only physical activity.

title: The effectiveness of multi-component goal setting interventions for changing physical activity behaviour: a systematic review and meta-analysis
authors: McEwan D, Harden SM, Zumbo BD, Sylvester BD, Kaulius M, Ruissen GR, Dowd AJ, Beauchamp MR
note: 45 articles, 52 interventions, n = 5912; multi-component goal-setting interventions.

title: The (over)use of SMART goals for physical activity promotion: A narrative review and critique
authors: Swann C, Jackman PC, Lawrence A, Hawkins RM, Goddard SG, Williamson O, Schweickle MJ, Vella SA, Rosenbaum S, Ekkekakis P
note: Narrative review and critique; abstract only.

title: Goal Setting in Exercise and Physical Activity: An Expert Statement on Behalf of Exercise and Sports Science Australia
authors: Swann C, Buchan J, Calleja EA, Goddard SG, Clarke MM, Hawkins RM, Jackman PC, Schweickle MJ, Vella SA, Rosenbaum S
note: Expert statement of a professional body (ESSA). Several recommendations rest on a small number of studies by the authors' own group (open goals).

title: Time to Form a Habit: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Health Behaviour Habit Formation and Its Determinants
authors: Singh B, Murphy A, Maher C, Smith AE
note: 20 studies, 2601 participants; most at high risk of bias; only 4 studies reported time to habit formation. Reports Lally et al. 2010 numbers (primary paper paywalled, not read).

title: Exercise habit formation in new gym members: a longitudinal study
authors: Kaushal N, Rhodes RE
note: 111 new gym members followed for 12 weeks; self-reported habit; abstract only.

title: The Effectiveness of Planning Interventions for Improving Physical Activity in the General Population: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
authors: Peng S, Othman AT, Yuan F, Liang J
venue: Int J Environ Res Public Health
note: 41 RCTs (35 meta-analysed), 5439 participants; action planning and coping planning.

title: Prevalence and predictors of dropout from high-intensity interval training in sedentary individuals: A meta-analysis
authors: Reljic D, Lampe D, Wolf F, Zopf Y, Herrmann HJ, Fischer J
note: 55 studies, 67 HIIT interventions, 1318 sedentary healthy adults; supervised research settings.

title: Adherence to physical activity in an unsupervised setting: Explanatory variables for high attrition rates among fitness center members
authors: Sperandei S, Vieira MC, Reis AC
note: Retrospective records of 5240 members of one fitness centre in Rio de Janeiro, 2005-2014.

title: Systematic review of maintenance of behavior change following physical activity and dietary interventions
authors: Fjeldsoe B, Neuhaus M, Winkler E, Eakin E
note: Systematic review without meta-analysis; 29 trials with follow-up at least 3 months after intervention end. More than 10 years old.

title: Do smartphone applications and activity trackers increase physical activity in adults? Systematic review, meta-analysis and metaregression
authors: Laranjo L, Ding D, Heleno B, Kocaballi B, Quiroz JC, Tong HL, Chahwan B, Neves AL, Gabarron E, Dao KP, Rodrigues D, Neves GC, Antunes ML, Coiera E, Bates DW
note: 28 RCTs meta-analysed, n = 7454 adults aged 18-65 without chronic illness.

title: Systematic review and meta-analysis of the effectiveness of chatbots on lifestyle behaviours
authors: Singh B, Olds T, Brinsley J, Dumuid D, Virgara R, Matricciani L, Watson A, Szeto K, Eglitis E, Miatke A, Simpson CEM, Vandelanotte C, Maher C
note: 19 trials (RCTs, non-randomised and pre-post); 74% low quality; mostly 6 weeks or shorter; pre-LLM chatbots for the most part (searched to September 2022).

title: The effect of chatbot-based exercise interventions on physical activity, exercise habits, and sedentary behavior: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
authors: Wang Q, Yang W, Xu K, Lam LT
note: 12 RCTs, 2446 participants, searched to October 2024.

title: Comprehensiveness, Accuracy, and Readability of Exercise Recommendations Provided by an AI-Based Chatbot: Mixed Methods Study
authors: Zaleski AL, Berkowsky R, Craig KJT, Pescatello LS
note: One AI chatbot prompted for 26 clinical populations; evaluates output content, not athlete outcomes.

title: Joint international consensus statement for ending stigma of obesity
authors: Rubino F, Puhl RM, Cummings DE, Eckel RH, Ryan DH, Mechanick JI, Nadglowski J, Ramos Salas X, Schauer PR, Twenefour D, Apovian CM, Aronne LJ, Batterham RL, Berthoud HR, Boza C, Busetto L, Dicker D, De Groot M, Eisenberg D, Flint SW, Huang TT, Kaplan LM, Kirwan JP, Korner J, Kyle TK, Laferrère B, le Roux CW, McIver L, Mingrone G, Nece P, Reid TJ, Rogers AM, Rosenbaum M, Seeley RJ, Torres AJ, Dixon JB
note: Modified Delphi consensus of 36 experts convened with 10 partner organisations.

title: What words should we use to talk about weight? A systematic review of quantitative and qualitative studies examining preferences for weight-related terminology
authors: Puhl RM
note: Systematic review of 33 studies (1999-2019); abstract only.

title: The effects of communicating uncertainty on public trust in facts and numbers
authors: van der Bles AM, van der Linden S, Freeman ALJ, Spiegelhalter DJ
venue: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
note: Five experiments (total n = 5780) on public-facing facts, not coaching; abstract only.

title: Key Factors Associated with Adherence to Physical Exercise in Patients with Chronic Diseases and Older Adults: An Umbrella Review
authors: Collado-Mateo D, Lavin-Perez AM, Penacoba C, Del Coso J, Leyton-Roman M, Luque-Casado A, Gasque P, Fernandez-Del-Olmo MA, Amado-Alonso D
venue: Int J Environ Res Public Health
note: Umbrella review of 55 reviews; factors are ranked by how often reviews named them, not by effect size.

title: Attrition and adherence rates of sustained vs. intermittent exercise interventions
authors: Linke SE, Gallo LC, Norman GJ
note: Systematic review of 14 RCTs (783 enrolled, mean age 42 years, 76% female). Over 10 years old; abstract only, no pooled rates.

title: Impact of implementation intentions on physical activity practice in adults: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials
authors: Silva MAVD, Sao-Joao TM, Brizon VC, Franco DH, Mialhe FL
note: 13 RCTs, ages 18-76, mixed populations including coronary disease, obesity, diabetes and sedentary adults.

title: Effectiveness of wearable activity trackers to increase physical activity and improve health: a systematic review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses
authors: Ferguson T, Olds T, Curtis R, Blake H, Crozier AJ, Dankiw K, Dumuid D, Kasai D, O'Connor E, Virgara R, Maher C
note: Umbrella review of 39 reviews, 163,992 participants, clinical and non-clinical populations.

title: Self-determination theory interventions for health behavior change: Meta-analysis and meta-analytic structural equation modeling of randomized controlled trials
authors: Sheeran P, Wright CE, Avishai A, Villegas ME, Lindemans JW, Klein WMP, Rothman AJ, Miles E, Ntoumanis N
note: 56 articles, 65 independent tests of SDT interventions across health behaviours (not only exercise).

title: Using Large Language Models to Enhance Exercise Recommendations and Physical Activity in Clinical and Healthy Populations: Scoping Review
authors: Lai X, Chen J, Lai Y, Huang S, Cai Y, Sun Z, Wang X, Pan K, Gao Q, Huang C
note: Scoping review, searches up to 21 March 2024; 11 studies included, mostly 2023-2024 ChatGPT-type models.

title: What can machine learning teach us about habit formation? Evidence from exercise and hygiene
authors: Buyalskaya A, Ho H, Milkman KL, Li X, Duckworth AL, Camerer C
venue: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
note: Observational panel data: over 12 million gym-attendance observations and over 40 million hospital handwashing observations.

title: Theoretical explanations for maintenance of behaviour change: a systematic review of behaviour theories
authors: Kwasnicka D, Dombrowski SU, White M, Sniehotta F
note: Systematic review of theories, not of intervention trials: it describes explanations, not effect sizes. Over 10 years old.

title: Overweight and obesity management (NICE guideline NG246)
authors: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
note: Published 14 January 2025, last updated 2026. UK clinical guideline for people living with overweight or obesity, not for athletes. The BEH claims use the behavioural-interventions chapter (recommendations 1.13 and 1.14); the NUT cluster uses the diet and physical-activity chapters.
